items.claim_and_conventions: Conditional five-channel bookkeeping definition for supplied Hilbert adjoints and shifted normal inverses; lambda is the coefficient of the squared penalty.
Countable-Choice Hilbert-space exact telescope, pointwise triangle bound, conditional operator/residual estimates, and explicit no-rate scope.
Exact finite-dimensional Tikhonov output for A_n=diag(1,...,1/n), zero truth, last-mode noise 1/n, and lambda=n^-4; error tends to one. No fixed-continuum convergence theorem is asserted.
